_readme: One copy of every page, three dictionaries. js/i18n.js swaps the text in
the browser and remembers the choice, so there is no es/ or fr/ folder and
nothing to regenerate when the English changes.
Strings are keyed by the English text, so a phrase used twice is translated
once and stays consistent, and no element needs a data-i18n attribute. Only
whole-element text is matched, never words inside a sentence.
To change an English string: edit the page, then edit the key here and in
es.json and fr.json. The checker will tell you if you miss one.
It reports strings with no translation, and keys that match nothing on any
page, which is what a reworded sentence looks like.
Note: one URL serves all three languages, so search engines index the
English. Separate /es/ and /fr/ pages would be indexed separately; this is
the trade for keeping a single set of files.

strings.Creating a listing required sellers to m: Creating a listing required sellers to move through a long, multi-step experience and manually enter all the information about their item. The process remains crucial for our marketplace supply quality and item discoverability, but for sellers it remains repetitive and hard to correct when something is wrong.
strings.At the same time, <strong>sellers had al: At the same time, sellers had already prepared their photos before entering the listing flow. This created an opportunity to explore whether photos could become the starting point for a faster, more assisted experience.
strings.How might we reduce the effort it takes: How might we reduce the effort it takes for sellers to create a listing?
strings.The discovery combined existing user res: The discovery combined existing user research, seller feedback, quantitative listing data, a UX audit of the current flow and a benchmark of competitor listing experiences.
strings.The research highlighted <strong>recurri: The research highlighted recurring friction around the length of the listing process, finding the right category or model, writing descriptions, understanding pricing and correcting information after submission.
strings.The process felt long and complex, espec: The process felt long and complex, especially when sellers had to complete many fields manually.
strings.Taxonomy and model selection did not alw: Taxonomy and model selection did not always reflect how sellers described their items.

strings.The discovery also surfaced several pain: The discovery also surfaced several pain points that were important to sellers but fell outside the scope of this revamp.
strings.Sellers still couldn't edit a listing on: Sellers still couldn't edit a listing once submitted. This remained on the roadmap, with the added consideration of the recropping and revalidation costs triggered by changes.

strings.Sellers reported long validation times a: Sellers reported long validation times and limited clarity around rejection reasons. These issues were primarily related to curation operations and were therefore addressed separately by the OPS team.
strings.The current taxonomy remains unchanged f: The current taxonomy remains unchanged for now due to its complexity, but it remains an area for future improvement.

strings.The challenge was not simply to add AI t: The challenge was not simply to add AI to the existing form. It was to create an experience that balanced speed, accuracy, clarity and seller control.

strings.The project started from a repetitive an: The project started from a repetitive and inefficient task in our Figma workflow: editing product tiles required manually preparing data.
strings.I used ChatGPT to help me create a custo: I used ChatGPT to help me create a custom Figma plugin, figuring out how to retrieve our product data as JSON and then match that data to the right Figma layers. I iterated through the technical challenges until the workflow was working reliably. The plugin became Vestiaire's first internally created Figma plugin, and I presented the process at a Tech Town Hall. The team can now either upload a JSON for specific products or use an integrated database of 300+ products.
strings.Saved the design team time by automating: Saved the design team time by automating a repetitive product-tile editing task.
